home.title: Fileutilo — Free Online PDF, Image & Document Tools (Private)
home.description: 31 free online tools to convert, merge, split, compress and clean PDFs, Word, Excel, images and data. Files stay on your device — nothing is uploaded.
home.h1: Free, private file tools that run in your browser
home.intro: Fileutilo brings 31 everyday file tools together in one place: convert documents, merge and split PDFs, compress images for form uploads, clean up spreadsheets, format JSON and more. Your files are processed inside your browser and are never uploaded to a server. That makes it fast, and safe for personal and work documents.
faqs: Is Fileutilo free?

Yes. Every tool can be used free of charge. A free account gives you 25 tasks a day; data tools like the JSON formatter and file diff have no daily limit. Pro removes Fileutilo's daily limits, file caps and ads.
Are my files uploaded?
No. Your files are processed inside your browser and are never uploaded to a server. Only your account details and payment records are stored, never your files.
Does it work on a phone?
Yes. Fileutilo works in any modern browser on Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac and Linux, with nothing to install.
